extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and their attorneys/agents preparing reissue applications; patent examiners; pro se inventors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance from MPEP §1413 on preparing, submitting, and amending drawings in a reissue patent application, including formatting, labeling, and procedural steps required by 37 CFR 1.173 and 1.84.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of clean copy of each drawing sheet at filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant must submit a clean copy of each drawing sheet of the printed patent at the time the reissue application is filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clean copy means good quality photocopies free of any extraneous markings. If such copy complies with 37 CFR 1.84, no further drawings will be required. The Office will not transfer the drawings from the patent file to the reissue application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not submit new drawing sheets unless changes are made
rubrics_metrics.description: New drawing sheets are not to be submitted, unless some change is made in the original patent drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If changes are made, they must be made in accordance with 37 CFR 1.173(b)(3) (see related entries on replacement sheets and labeling).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments must be submitted as replacement sheets attached to the amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Any changes to a patent drawing must be submitted as a replacement sheet of drawings which shall be an attachment to the amendment document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any replacement sheet of drawings must be in compliance with § 1.84 and shall include all of the figures appearing on the original version of the sheet, even if only one figure is amended.

rubrics_metrics.name: All figures from original sheet must appear on replacement sheet
rubrics_metrics.description: Replacement sheets must include all of the figures appearing on the original version of the sheet, even if only one figure is being amended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This prevents submitting only the amended figure alone; the full original sheet's figures must be present on the replacement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labeling of amended, new, and canceled figures
rubrics_metrics.description: Amended figures must be identified as "Amended," any added figure must be identified as "New," and canceled figures must be surrounded by brackets and identified as "Canceled."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each figure that is amended must be identified by placing the word "Amended" at the bottom of that figure. In the event that a figure is canceled, the figure must be identified as "Canceled" and also surrounded by brackets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explain all drawing changes in detail on a separate sheet
rubrics_metrics.description: All changes to the drawing(s) shall be explained, in detail, beginning on a separate sheet accompanying the papers including the amendment to the drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The detailed explanation must accompany the amendment papers and should describe each change to the figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not physically alter original or printed patent drawing sheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Amending the original or printed patent drawing sheets by physically changing or altering them is not permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any request to physically change or alter the original/printed patent drawings should be denied; replacement sheets must be used instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annotated marked-up drawings: optional to include, required on examiner request
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant may include a marked-up copy of any amended drawing figure, including annotations indicating the changes made, labeled "Annotated Marked-up Drawings."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such a marked-up copy must be presented in the amendment or remarks section that explains the change to the drawings. The examiner may request a marked-up copy in an Office action; when required by the examiner, a marked-up copy including annotations must be provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner will notify applicant if drawing changes are not approved or sheets not entered
rubrics_metrics.description: If any drawing change is not approved, or if any submitted sheet of drawings is not entered, the examiner will inform the reissue applicant in the next Office action and set forth the reasons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect a written explanation in the Office action detailing why a change was not approved or why a sheet was not entered.
